answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The dune is the island, the voyage the endorsement that crosses it, and the ripple the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one dune is cheap to hold, but a voyage only counts when no ripple exists, and that takes independent history.
